text:
morgan_pm: quick sync — we need a single-page GA onboarding checklist for SDK/embedded customers. audience: sales/legal/ops + customer success. must be short and actionable: SLA summary, pricing triggers, docs required, support commitments, and monitoring handoffs.

alex_eng: ok — what are the absolutely required items?

morgan_pm: non-negotiables:
1) SLA headline (availability numbers + incident response windows)
2) Required customer docs & minimal examples (auth, token refresh, retry/backoff)
3) Support model (hours, P1/P2 routing, oncall owner links)
4) Observability basics (dashboards to share + alert knobs)
5) Pricing behavior (quota, burst rules, overage handling)
6) Deployment modes & when to recommend Dedicated/Private.

jia_sre: add: expected latency bands by tier and fallback behavior (which model we fall back to). call out warmup times for dedicated pools.

sofia_support: for support readiness we need: top-5 canned playbooks for week-0 problems (auth failures, quota hits, degraded throughput, model regressions, invoice disputes). include 1-line owner and escalation path for each.

tariq_finops: pricing note: document how reserved capacity vs meter billing interacts and what customers see on billing page when throttling starts. also include example invoice scenarios.

alex_eng: draft SLA numbers for GA: hosted 99.9% availability; dedicated 99.95%; P1 ack <1h, P2 ack <4h. list common exceptions (third-party cloud outage, customer network).

morgan_pm: good — include mitigation steps and credit policy for persistent SLA misses.

jia_sre: monitoring: we'll publish a shared dashboard with p50/p95/p99 latency, error rate, queue depth, GPU utilization. alert rules: sustained error rate >0.5% for 5m -> page; p99 latency > X ms for dedicated -> page. exact thresholds in doc.

sofia_support: training: record a 1hr enablement + short FAQ for customers. internal playbook with curl repros and sample traces.

alex_eng: I'll add an SDK quickstart snippet showing token rotation + retry.

morgan_pm: also add a short section: recommended configs for high-throughput customers (batching, KV cache hints, quantization compatibility).

jia_sre: rollout staging: internal beta (1-2 accounts) -> small customers <=1M tokens/day -> mid customers 1-50M (finance sign-off) -> enterprise on Dedicated. each stage needs SLA signoff, billing review, and runbook verified.

tariq_finops: for stages 3-4 finance gating required: approved quota/commit or trial commit option with soft cap. pre-announce overage rules.

sofia_support: question: custom SLAs? propose process: request -> AM -> legal -> finance -> SLA addendum. include sample addendum clause for credits.

morgan_pm: timeline note: expect 2-4 week negotiation for custom SLAs. add as 'negotiation lead time'.

alex_eng: add a compatibility matrix: SDK version -> runtime version -> model quantization supported. prevents mismatches.

jia_sre: troubleshooting cheat-sheet: 1) reproduce with minimal curl 2) check quota & billing UI 3) verify region routing / fallback 4) attach perf trace and escalate.

legal_bot: draft checklist page created at https://docs.internal/redwood/ga-onepager-draft (auto).

morgan_pm: owners: alex -> quickstart + SDK snippet; jia -> monitoring & runbooks; sofia -> support playbooks + training; tariq -> pricing + invoice examples. I'll collate by EOD Wed and run a 30-min signoff Thu. call out red flags now.

sofia_support: red flag: staffing for P1s on weekends — need written commit for first 90 days, otherwise don't promise 24/7.

jia_sre: agree — we can support weekend escalation but need to define coverage window in doc.

tariq_finops: red flag: reserved capacity pricing approvals can slow deals. suggest a 30-day trial commit path.

alex_eng: engineering red flag: some large models have ~10-15m cold warmup for dedicated pools. document pre-warm options and recommended customer pre-warm scripts.

morgan_pm: perfect. I'll add a 'deal-breakers & mitigations' section with those points. please paste short paragraphs to the draft link and I'll merge. :thumbsup:
